title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on 4x MI300A
summary: Source-backed campaign trace from the original Claude session and its Round 15 continuation.
provenance: 82 plotted points from Claude session a2d3319a-c2c4-444f-a440-4881f158f32c; Round 15 continuation points from 9ae9a100-f067-4aa1-8334-2589bd573a6c. Per-point agent attribution is unknown. Workstream windows, role assignments, and turn text are curated reconstructions from transcript evidence, not backend events.

objective.title: Maximize goodput under latency and correctness gates
objective.statement: Build a from-scratch OpenAI-compatible Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MXFP4 server on one 4x MI300A node and maximize the corrected load-ramp goodput while preserving the campaign gates.
constraints: Keep the benchmark version visible because v4 and v5 workloads are not directly comparable.
Workload: 3–6 turns, 1–8 seconds think time, up to 48 sessions, greedy decoding with ignore-EOS, exactly 80–300 generated tokens.
Accuracy: 13 probes plus pins; at least 90% exact on the first 32 tokens, and no divergence before token 8 for the remaining probes.
Benchmark integrity: no dropped, errored, empty, or wrong-length outputs.
Use one node with 4x MI300A GPUs on ROCm.
Do not import, copy, or install SGLang, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM engine code.
